name: The Luciferans
description: A misguided Infernal tradition that worships Lucifer as a kinder, benevolent God; strongest in 1220 within the Church in Germany, Austria and Bohemia.

name: Strigae
description: Misguided Infernal tradition of night witches who worship demons as pagan gods, gathering in covens of 13 led by a senior infernalist bound to a demon.

name: The Witch-Hammers
description: Unusual Infernal tradition of overzealous inquisitors who unknowingly practice maleficia while persecuting other supposed witches and heretics, guided by the malleus epistula.

name: Dark Gnostics
description: Corrupt Infernal tradition of Gnostic heretics who preach that sinful acts have moral value, often using the serpent as their symbol.

name: Gnostics
description: Varied religious groups of the first millennium teaching that the world is Hell and the Old Testament God was the Devil; credited by the Church with spreading devil-worship.

name: The Dread Host
description: Corrupt Infernal tradition whose members bind demons and the dead, seeking to become Infernal ghosts in Hell's hierarchy after death.

name: The Mulhidun
description: Infernal tradition of devil-worshipers near Mosul and Seljuk lands who revere Enais, the Peacock Angel, and summon and command demons as servants.

name: Damhadh-Duidsan
description: Infernal Hermetic societas descended from the hedge wizard Damhadh-Duidas within House Ex Miscellanea, using Ogam runes for curses.

name: Ordo Vagorum
description: The 'Order of Vagrants', a mock religious order of wandering clerks (vagantes) that is an Infernal societas, with chapters in Paris, Austria and northern Italy.

name: Goliards
description: Name for the hedonist vagantes, supposedly after Bishop Golias; also a Mercere societas of Redcaps with loose ties to the Ordo Vagorum.

name: Vagi Scholares
description: 'Wandering scholars', a lesser chapter of the Ordo Vagorum centered in Austria and the eastern Alps.

name: Eberhardini
description: A clan of vagantes from northern Italy forming one chapter of the Ordo Vagorum.

name: Witches of Thessaly
description: Infernal Hermetic societas of Thessalian witches, some of whom joined House Ex Miscellanea, practicing chthonic magic and curses.

name: Daughters of Erictho
description: The 'wild' Thessalian witches who never joined the Order, dwelling in the Cambunian Mountains; mostly infernalists.

name: Benandanti
description: Nightwalkers of northeast Italy, born with a caul, who battle the stregoni in dreams with fennel swords using powers of the same Infernal realm.

name: Stregoni
description: Evil witches of northeast Italy who transform into owls to spread misfortune, each group ruled by a male witch (strego).

name: Ophites
description: Gnostic sect that worships the serpent of paradise as the symbol of God and revels in original sin.

name: Brethren of the Free Spirit
description: Gnostic sect with Infernal ties teaching that each member is God and so may indulge every desire.

name: Cathars
description: Southern French heretics whom the Luciferans try to infiltrate; Catharism is a Gnostic-derived Divine religion.

name: Orléans Heretics
description: Heretical priests uncovered in Orléans in 1022, accused by Aréfast of orgies and demon summoning; some escaped.

name: Princes of Mecklenburg
description: Declining Sorbian noble family in northern Germany who worship the demon Radegast and are members of the Dread Host.

name: Yezidi
description: Real-world Kurdish religion venerating Malak Ta'us, the Peacock Angel, oppressed as devil-worshipers; distinct from the Mulhidun.

name: Volkhvy
description: Primitive pagan shamans of the Novgorod Tribunal.

name: Koldun
description: Volkhvy who have forsaken pagan ways for sorcery, similar to the witches of Thessaly.

name: Cistercian Order
description: Monastic order whose vows Joachim of Flora took.

name: Ordo Miscellany
description: Pralix's alliance of hedge wizards that fought Damhan-Allaidh and became House Ex Miscellanea.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi, not immune to Infernal corruption among its members.

name: Seljuks
description: Rulers of lands east of the Byzantine Empire where the Mulhidun live.

name: Fourth Lateran Council
description: Church council that condemned Joachim of Flora's essays as heretical.

name: Council of Ancyra
description: Council of 314 A.D. to which the Canon Episcopi is allegedly attributed.

name: House Guernicus
description: Hermetic House of the Quaesitores; its first Primus Fenicil found a letter like the malleus epistula, and the Duresca scrolls suggest a secret agenda.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: Hermetic House formed from the Ordo Miscellany that absorbed the Damhadh-Duidsan and some Thessalian witches.

name: House Mercere
description: House of the Redcaps; some Redcaps are infernalist Goliards whose exposure the House fears.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House with ties to universities; suitable for a magus vaganti.

name: House Diedne
description: Outcast Hermetic House whose treatment is feared; speculated to have had chthonically tainted magic.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House referenced through the treatment of Tytalus diabolists.

name: Tribunal of Thebes
description: Hermetic Tribunal encompassing Thessaly.

name: Novgorod Tribunal
description: Pagan-land Tribunal home to the Volkhvy and Koldun.

name: Fudarus
description: Place where the Redcap Golias allegedly lived with infernalists.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigators; some call overzealous inquisitors 'witch-hammers' and watch suspected infernalists.

name: Hoplite
description: Hermetic enforcers who regard the Daughters of Erictho as enemies of the Order.

name: Redcap
description: Messengers of House Mercere, some of whom have joined the Goliards.

name: Infernalist
description: A person who practices Infernal powers or worship, knowingly or not.

name: Diabolist
description: Mythic Companion template used for non-Gifted members of Infernal traditions.

name: Spirit Master
description: Character design template recommended for the Daughters of Erictho.

name: Mythic Companion
description: Powerful companion character type used for Diabolists and Daughters of Erictho.

name: Hedge Wizard
description: Non-Hermetic wizard such as Damhadh-Duidas.

name: Vagantes
description: Wandering tonsured clerks who become strolling players; members of the Ordo Vagorum.

name: Lucifer
description: The light-bringer who led the rebellion against Heaven; worshiped by the Luciferans as a benevolent God.

name: The Devil
description: Satan, adversary whose wiles corrupt mankind; popularly imagined as a shaggy masculine demon.

name: St. Paul
description: Apostle regarded by Luciferans as the first Luciferan and their patron saint, his vision on the road to Damascus being sent by Lucifer.

name: St. John
description: Author of Revelation who, Luciferans claim, mistook Lucifer for Christ.

name: Jesus Christ
description: Christian savior, voice in Paul's vision.

name: Pan
description: Wild god of satyrs and faerie revelry whose supposed death left a void demons exploited.

name: Diana
description: Roman goddess of the hunt; name given to a she-demon worshiped by strigae.

name: Herodias
description: Evil biblical woman; name given by the educated to the she-demon of the strigae.

name: Fenicil
description: First Primus of House Guernicus who reportedly burned a diabolical letter resembling the malleus epistula.

name: Conrad
description: Inquisitor described in the 1233 letter who suggested names of accused to victims.

name: Pope Gregory IX
description: Pope to whom the Archbishop of Mainz wrote in 1233 about the inquisitor Conrad.

name: Archbishop of Mainz
description: Wrote to Pope Gregory IX in 1233 about abuses of inquisition.

name: St. Jerome
description: Churchman to whom some copies of the malleus epistula are attributed.

name: Pope Leo
description: Pope to whom some copies of the malleus epistula are attributed.

name: Origen
description: Theologian impossibly credited with one version of the malleus epistula.

name: Charlemagne
description: Emperor claimed as signatory on 1220 copies of the malleus epistula.

name: Pope Innocent III
description: Pope claimed as signatory on 1220 copies of the malleus epistula.

name: Aréfast
description: Nobleman of northern France who exposed the Orléans heretics in 1022 using inquisitorial methods.

name: Bishop of Orléans
description: Feared not all Orléans heretics had been captured.

name: Joachim of Flora
description: Half-mythical Calabrian abbot and prophet who predicted a new age in 1260; revered by Gnostic infernalists.

name: Merlin
description: Figure of romance to whom Joachim is compared.

name: Judith
description: Biblical widow whose story Joachim used to calculate 1260.

name: Radegast
description: Demon (possibly former faerie lord or ancestor) worshiped by the Princes of Mecklenburg.

name: Adolv
description: Very old Count of Mecklenburg, his life sustained by spirits bound to his body.

name: Mechthild
description: Countess of Mecklenburg and most powerful member of the family, skilled at Summoning and Binding with Hierarchy Score 7.

name: Kaspar
description: Mechthild's eldest son from a previous marriage, physically dominant but dimwitted, holding real power in the castle.

name: Miklos
description: Illegitimate Gifted son of a Mecklenburg who refuses to worship Radegast.

name: Enais
description: The Peacock Angel revered by the Mulhidun, who extinguished Hell's fires and released its demons.

name: Malak Ta'us
description: The Peacock Angel of the real Yezidi religion.

name: Sheikh Adii ibn Mustafa
description: Reformer of the Yezidi religion in 1162, considered a saint.

name: Pralix
description: Leader of the crusade against Damhan-Allaidh whose death Damhadh-Duidas may have caused.

name: Damhan-Allaidh
description: The Spider, hedge wizard crushed by Pralix in 814, perhaps not wholly vanquished.

name: Damhadh-Duidas
description: Gaelic hedge wizard ('malice-writer') who joined the Ordo Miscellany and founded the Infernal Damhadh-Duidsan lineage.

name: Bishop Golias
description: Tenth-century hedonist after whom Goliards are named; said to have been a Redcap living at Fudarus.

name: Erictho
description: Legendary Thessalian witch described in Lucan's Pharsalia, namesake of the Daughters of Erictho.

name: Trianoma
description: Hermetic figure who came from Thessaly.

name: Veia
description: Trianoma's sister who stole secrets from Bonisagus and fled.

name: Bonisagus
description: Hermetic founder from whom Veia stole secrets.

name: Lucan
description: Author of the Pharsalia describing Erictho.

name: Selene
description: Succubus named for the Greek goddess, summoned by the Daughters in the rite of drawing down the moon.

name: Demon
description: Fallen beings of the Infernal realm that deceive and corrupt mankind.

name: Spirit of Deceit
description: Demon type that deludes mankind; one disguised as a snake corrupts a parish in a story hook.

name: Deluders
description: Demons that trick men into thinking them divine.

name: False Gods
description: Demons around which cults form, teaching worship is not sinful.

name: Lilin
description: Demons that accompany stregoni covens.

name: Furies
description: Order of demons, a member of which may accompany a strego's coven.

name: White Horseman
description: Demon released by breaking the first seal, a conqueror with a bow.

name: Red Horseman
description: Demon of the second seal who takes peace from the earth.

name: Black Horseman
description: Demon of the third seal bearing balances.

name: Pale Horseman
description: Demon of the fourth seal named Death, followed by Hell.

name: Great Beast
description: Apocalyptic beast numbered 666, which Luciferans say refers to Rome.

name: Serpent of Eden
description: Serpent of paradise honored by the Ophites as God.

name: Infernal Ghost
description: What Dread Host members hope to become after death, demons in Hell's hierarchy.

name: Giants
description: Ancestors of Damhan-Allaidh and Damhadh-Duidas.

name: Malleus Epistula
description: Chain letter from the 5th century instructing inquisitors to torture and burn witches; a summa (Quality 26) on the Witch-Hammer Favored Abilities.

name: Duresca Scrolls
description: Documents unearthed in Iberia suggesting a House Guernicus agenda, describing the Peripheral Code as malleus magorum.

name: Canon Episcopi
description: Church document declaring night rides illusions of faithless minds.

name: Book of Revelation
description: Biblical book the Luciferans interpret as Lucifer's triumph; sacred to Yezidis.

name: Black Book
description: Sacred Yezidi text.

name: Seven Seals
description: Seals of the great book of the heavens that Luciferans break to loose demons of the Apocalypse.

name: Kolossoi
description: Dolls or figurines used by Thessalian witches for vengeful hexes.

name: Virus Lunare
description: 'Moon-juice' left by Selene, acting as an Arcane Connection to the seduced man.

name: Infernal Relics
description: Objects binding the dead, sold by the Dread Host as false relics.

name: Pharsalia
description: Lucan's work of 65 A.D. describing Erictho.

name: Debauchery
description: Infernal Power favored by Luciferans and Strigae.

name: Diablerie
description: Infernal Power favored by Luciferans and Dark Gnostics.

name: Malediction
description: Infernal cursing Power.

name: Sense Passions
description: Infernal Ability favored by Luciferans.

name: Effusion
description: Infernal Power favored by Strigae and the Dread Host.

name: Phantasm
description: Infernal Power favored by Strigae and Dark Gnostics.

name: Ceremony
description: Infernal ability favored by Strigae.

name: Ablating
description: Infernal Power favored by Witch-Hammers and Mulhidun.

name: Incantation
description: Infernal Method favored by several traditions.

name: Psychomachia
description: Infernal Power favored by Witch-Hammers and Ordo Vagorum.

name: Summoning
description: Infernal Power for calling demons.

name: Entrancement
description: Ability favored by Dark Gnostics.

name: Binding
description: Infernal Power for binding spirits.

name: Commanding
description: Infernal Power for commanding spirits.

name: Consumption
description: Infernal Power favored by Damhadh-Duidsan and Ordo Vagorum.

name: Shapechanging
description: Ability favored by Damhadh-Duidsan.

name: Corruption
description: Infernal Power favored by Ordo Vagorum.

name: Chthonic Magic
description: Supernatural Ability of the Witches of Thessaly.

name: Hex
description: Ability favored by the Witches of Thessaly.

name: Language
description: Ability; score 2 needed to use Ogam.

name: Purity
description: Divine Power that Debauchery may be disguised as for unknowing Luciferans.

name: Adjuration
description: Divine Power that Diablerie may be disguised as.

name: Cursing
description: Divine Power that Malediction may be disguised as.

name: Giant Blood
description: Virtue very common among the Damhadh-Duidsan.

name: Puissant Corpus
description: Free Virtue for Damhadh-Duidsan magi.

name: Necessary Condition
description: Flaw (runes) for Damhadh-Duidsan magi.

name: Clerk
description: Required option for Goliards.

name: Educated
description: Alternative requirement for Goliards.

name: Compulsion
description: Goliards must have a sinful Compulsion.

name: Diabolic Past
description: Explains an Infernal background for vagantes.

name: Student of the Infernal
description: Explains an Infernal background for vagantes.

name: Affinity with Vim
description: Free Virtue for Thessalian Ex Miscellanea magi.

name: Painful Magic
description: Free Flaw for Thessalian Ex Miscellanea magi.

name: The Gift
description: Magical aptitude; Miklos has it, and a Daughter's child has a False Gift.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form in which Thessalians have Affinity.

name: Infernal Traditions
description: Optional groups of like-minded infernalists defined by Methods, Powers and Favored Abilities.

name: Misguided Traditions
description: Infernal traditions deluded into believing they do good.

name: Corrupt Traditions
description: Infernal traditions of knowingly evil people or placatory cults.

name: Hermetic Traditions
description: Infernal societates within the Order of Hermes.

name: Methods and Powers
description: Infernal Methods associated with Powers; new Powers need a Method and Methods at least two Powers.

name: Infernal Supernatural Abilities
description: Also Supernatural Virtues takable at creation or initiated via corrupt Mystery Cults.

name: Maleficia
description: Infernal sorcery used by infernalists.

name: Infernalism
description: Practice of using Infernal power, always producing evil.

name: Favored Abilities
description: Abilities associated with each Infernal tradition.

name: Hermetic Mystery Cult
description: Cult whose corrupted rites may initiate Infernal abilities.

name: Hermetic Societas
description: A regular gathering of like-minded magi to practice and teach; plural societates.

name: Vis
description: Magical resource; the Benandanti battle protects a vis source.

name: Vis Prava
description: Corrupted vis resulting if the stregoni win.

name: Debilitation
description: Condition inflicted on those killed in a night battle.

name: Infernal Might
description: Might score of demons.

name: Hierarchy Score
description: Measure of Infernal standing; Mechthild has 7.

name: Danse Macabre
description: Dread Host practice of possessed troupes dancing to death.

name: Drawing Down the Moon
description: Thessalian sexual sorcery now summoning Selene.

name: Ogam
description: Gaelic arcane writing used by the Damhadh-Duidsan for incantations.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Link to a target; virus lunare serves as one.

name: Hermetic Oath
description: Oath sworn to join the Order.

name: Peripheral Code
description: Hermetic law called malleus magorum in the Duresca scrolls.

name: True Names
description: Demonic names recorded in Mulhidun grimoires.

name: Test of the Cold Water
description: Ordeal to prove guilt mentioned in the malleus epistula.

name: Wizard's March
description: Hermetic outlawry; infernalist Redcaps could be Marched.

name: Spontaneous Casting
description: Magic skill attributed to House Diedne.

name: Regio
description: Faerie regiones reached through portals near Thessalian caves.

name: Infernal Realm
description: Realm of Hell and demons.

name: Divine Realm
description: Realm of God.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm of magic.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Realm of faeries.

name: Dominion
description: Divine influence encroaching on pagan power.

name: Hell
description: Infernal abode of demons.

name: Heaven
description: Paradise from which demons were cast out.

name: Damascus
description: City on whose road Saul had his vision.

name: Jerusalem
description: City Saul sought to bring prisoners to.

name: Rome
description: City Luciferans identify with the Great Beast.

name: Germany
description: Region of Luciferan strength and the Mecklenburgs.

name: Austria
description: Region of Luciferans and Vagi Scholares.

name: Bohemia
description: Region with Luciferan strength.

name: Cologne
description: City with a thriving Luciferan community.

name: Krems
description: City near Vienna with a Luciferan community.

name: Vienna
description: City near Krems.

name: Iberia
description: Where the Duresca scrolls were found.

name: Orléans
description: Town where heresy was uncovered in 1022.

name: Cathedral of Sainte Croix
description: Cathedral in Orléans whose priests were arrested.

name: Calabria
description: Homeland of Joachim of Flora.

name: Curazzo
description: Monastery Joachim was made abbot of.

name: Mecklenburg
description: Seat of the Princes of Mecklenburg in northern Germany.

name: Rostock
description: City near Mecklenburg.

name: Lübeck
description: City near Mecklenburg.

name: Mosul
description: Persian city north of which the Mulhidun live.

name: Byzantine Empire
description: Empire west of Mulhidun lands.

name: Persia
description: Region of the Mulhidun.

name: Armenia
description: Region of the Mulhidun hills.

name: British Isles
description: Where Pralix crushed Damhan-Allaidh.

name: Paris
description: Center of the Ordo Vagorum.

name: Thessaly
description: Greek region home to the Thessalian witches.

name: Cambunian Mountains
description: Mountains where the Daughters of Erictho dwell.

name: Greece
description: Region reached by Ex Miscellanea.

name: Garden of Eden
description: Paradise of the serpent.
